title: Systems-Item Cash Settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty: Offer and Written Acceptance
content:
## Conditions of offer

A systems-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty is cash paid to the homeowner in place of Calloway repairing a covered systems claim item (plumbing, electrical or hvac). A systems-item cash settlement is offered on the claim item of the most recent systems approval recorded on the coverage, whether that approval is the item's original approval or an accepted callback, and it becomes a payout only when the homeowner accepts it in writing.

A systems settlement is not offered to the homeowner, and no cash-in-lieu payout is approved on it, until every emergency dispatch recorded on the coverage that the dispatch charge rules make chargeable carries its emergency dispatch charge.

On acceptance the settlement is recorded as an approved payout of the kind cash in lieu for that claim item, with its own payout number, and its amount is added to the payouts Calloway owes the homeowner on the coverage; the item is thereby closed without repair.

## Recording the homeowner's acceptance

Tool: `accept_systems_item_cash_settlement_9ecd6f20`. This is the homeowner's own tool: the desk agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the homeowner) runs it to record their own written acceptance. One run records one approved payout, dated the day of the run.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | The reference number of the homeowner's own warranty coverage on the home, as given to the homeowner by the warranty desk from the coverage lookup | Identifier, as given by the desk |
| `claim_item_ref` | The service request item number of the systems item being settled | Copied character for character, digits and hyphens included, exactly as printed on the homeowner's service request, with no reformatting |
| `amount` | The cash settlement amount the homeowner accepts, in US dollars | A positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the nearest cent; no currency sign or thousands separator |

## What the run returns

A receipt whose `status` is `settlement_accepted` means the acceptance is on file. The receipt also gives `warranty_event_id` (reference number of the new payout entry), `payout_reference` (the payout number, text such as WPO-51234), `coverage_id` (the coverage the payout belongs to), `claim_item_ref` (the item settled and closed), `payout_type` (always `cash_in_lieu`), `amount` (US dollars, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the acceptance date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `payouts_owed` (approved payouts not yet paid on the coverage including this acceptance, US dollars, 2 decimal places).
